title: Signal: Kubernetes Secret manifest served in a response
scope: One response body containing a Kubernetes Secret manifest with a data or stringData block.
limitations: One response body. The check recognises the manifest shape; it does not decode or use the values.

observation.body:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db
 type: Opaque
data:
  password: cGxhY2Vob2xkZXItdmFsdWU=

kind: Secret
apiVersion: v1
stringData:
  token: placeholder-value
  user: app

apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
clusters:
  - name: prod
    cluster:
      server: https://k8s.example:6443

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 2

fpNotes: A kubeconfig, Deployment or ConfigMap manifest is not reported; a documentation page that shows a Secret skeleton without values is reported only when a data block with content is present.
